title: Frontiers: Algorithmic Collusion: Supra-competitive Prices via Independent Algorithms
authors: Karsten T. Hansen; Kanishka Misra; Mallesh M. Pai
eligible_reason: Not a DiD. Simulation study of independent bandit pricing algorithms (competing bandits) showing supra-competitive long-run prices; no regression design on observational data.
design_notes: Code/competing bandits_general.R with MC settings and functions_logit.R run Monte Carlo simulations; chart scripts make the paper figures. Amazon marketplace data referenced from Chen, Mislove and Wilson (2016) but not shipped.
data_files_note: Read_me.txt: Amazon data are large and available from the original source; not included.
data_provenance_note: Simulation code only; external Amazon data not shipped.
screener_notes: No article text or PDF available locally (data/text/mksc and papers/mksc checked Nov 2); the OpenAlex abstract in data/frame/mksc.jsonl is a one-sentence summary. Design read from the README and the main-results code; no package code was run.
